projects.name: Developed an AI-powered tool that processes PDFs (e.g., emailers, e-details) to extract and analyze
details: content intelligently, using advanced vision and NLP techniques. This platform provides intelligent content analysis and
actionable insights for end clients.
• Key Message Tagging: Fine-tuned a multi-class classification model using BERT to identify and tag critical key messages,
enhancing automated content analysis.
• Image/Text Semantic Modeling: Implemented transfer learning to build a robust image/text similarity model.
• Multilingual NER Model: Utilized SpaCy and Hugging Face frameworks to extract NER in 12+ languages, expanding the
tool's global applicability for a diverse clientele.
• MLOps Implementation: Designed a comprehensive data science pipeline with data collection, model retraining, and
model deployment, leveraging AWS and MLFlow for iterative model updates based on feedback loops.
Impact:
• Achieved 70–80% accuracy across domain-specific models with iterative retraining, ensuring reliable content extraction for
enterprise clients.
• Enabled seamless processing of PDFs on demand, supporting multiple clients under subscription models for PDF
processing.
